title: Kachin: where Myanmar’s rare earth minerals are in tight grip
html:
Kachin: where Myanmar’s rare earth minerals are in tight grip

In Myanmar’s northern state of Kachin lies millions of dollars worth of rare earth minerals. Al Jazeera’s Tony Cheng reports on how access to these minerals is not easy for the United States due to its geographic proximity to China.
summary: In Myanmar’s northern state of Kachin lies millions of dollars worth of rare earth minerals.
